\label{lemma-pullback-virtual-normal-sheaf}
Let $(S, \delta)$ be as in Situation \ref{situation-setup}. Let
$$
\xymatrix{
Z' \ar[r] \ar[d]_g & X' \ar[d]^f \\
Z \ar[r] & X
}
$$
be a cartesian diagram of schemes locally of finite type over $S$
whose horizontal arrows are closed immersions.
If $\mathcal{N}$ is a virtual normal sheaf for $Z$ in $X$, then
$\mathcal{N}' = g^*\mathcal{N}$ is a virtual normal sheaf for
$Z'$ in $X'$.

Let $S$ be a locally Noetherian universally catenary scheme equipped with a dimension function $\delta:S\to\mathbf Z$. For any $S$-scheme $T$ locally of finite type, write $\delta_T(t)=\delta(f(t))+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(f(t))}\kappa(t)$; for integral closed $W\subset T$, let $\dim_\delta W=\delta_T(\eta_W)$.

A $q$-cycle on $T$ is a locally finite integral linear combination of integral closed subschemes of $\delta$-dimension $q$; $Z_q(T)$ is the group of these cycles. For a closed subscheme $W$ of dimension at most $q$, $[W]_q$ is the sum of the $q$-dimensional components weighted by generic-point length multiplicities. The Chow group $\mathrm{CH}_q(T)$ is $Z_q(T)$ modulo rational equivalence generated by locally finite principal divisors on integral closed subschemes of dimension $q+1$.

For a morphism $f:X\to Y$ and integer $p$, a bivariant class $c\in A^p(X\to Y)$ is a collection of homomorphisms $c_T:\mathrm{CH}_q(T)\to\mathrm{CH}_{q-p}(X\times_YT)$ indexed by $T\to Y$ and $q$, satisfying: (i) for proper $h:T'\to T$, $c_T(h_*\beta)=h_{X,*}c_{T'}(\beta)$; (ii) for flat $h$ of fixed relative dimension, $c_{T'}(h^*\alpha)=h_X^*c_T(\alpha)$; (iii) for $i:E\hookrightarrow T$ the zero scheme of a section of an invertible sheaf, $c_E(i^*\alpha)=i_X^*c_T(\alpha)$, with $h_X,i_X$ the base changes. Composition of families gives products $A^p(X\to Y)\times A^q(Y\to Z)\to A^{p+q}(X\to Z)$, and $A^*(X)=\bigoplus_pA^p(X\to X)$.

For a closed immersion $j:Z\hookrightarrow X$, let $\mathcal C_{Z/X}=\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2$ be its conormal sheaf. A virtual normal sheaf for $Z$ in $X$ consists of a finite locally free $\mathcal N$ on $Z$ and a specified surjection $\mathcal N^\vee\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal C_{Z/X}$. The induced closed immersion of the normal cone $C_ZX=\operatorname{Spec}_Z\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\mathcal I^n/\mathcal I^{n+1}$ into the vector bundle $\operatorname{Spec}_Z\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal N^\vee)$ defines the associated completed bivariant Gysin class $c(Z\to X,\mathcal N)\in A^*(Z\to X)^\wedge$ via deformation to the normal cone. If $\mathcal N$ has constant rank $r$, this class has degree $r$. Pullback of this class along a morphism over $X$ is denoted $\operatorname{res}$; $c_{\mathrm{top}}(\mathcal E)$ means $c_{\operatorname{rank}\mathcal E}(\mathcal E)$.

Let
$$
\xymatrix{
Z' \ar[r] \ar[d]_g & X' \ar[d]^f \\
Z \ar[r] & X
}
$$
be a cartesian diagram of schemes locally of finite type over $S$
whose horizontal arrows are closed immersions.
If $\mathcal{N}$ is a virtual normal sheaf for $Z$ in $X$, then
$\mathcal{N}' = g^*\mathcal{N}$ is a virtual normal sheaf for
$Z'$ in $X'$.

\label{lemma-gysin-decompose}
Let $(S, \delta)$ be as in Situation \ref{situation-setup}. Let $X$ be a scheme
locally of finite type over $S$. Let $\mathcal{N}$ be a virtual normal
sheaf for a closed subscheme $Z$ of $X$. Suppose that we have a short
exact sequence $0 \to \mathcal{N}' \to \mathcal{N} \to \mathcal{E} \to 0$
of finite locally free $\mathcal{O}_Z$-modules such that the given surjection
$\sigma : \mathcal{N}^\vee \to \mathcal{C}_{Z/X}$ factors through a map
$\sigma' : (\mathcal{N}')^\vee \to \mathcal{C}_{Z/X}$.
Then
$$
c(Z \to X, \mathcal{N}) = c_{top}(\mathcal{E}) \circ c(Z \to X, \mathcal{N}')
$$
as bivariant classes.

\label{lemma-gysin-excess}
Let $(S, \delta)$ be as in Situation \ref{situation-setup}. Consider
a cartesian diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
Z' \ar[r] \ar[d]_g & X' \ar[d]^f \\
Z \ar[r] & X
}
$$
of schemes locally of finite type over $S$ whose horizontal arrows
are closed immersions. Let $\mathcal{N}$, resp.\ $\mathcal{N}'$
be a virtual normal sheaf for $Z \subset X$, resp.\ $Z' \to X'$.
Assume given a short exact sequence
$0 \to \mathcal{N}' \to g^*\mathcal{N} \to \mathcal{E} \to 0$
of finite locally free modules on $Z'$ such that the diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
g^*\mathcal{N}^\vee \ar[r] \ar[d] &
(\mathcal{N}')^\vee \ar[d] \\
g^*\mathcal{C}_{Z/X} \ar[r] &
\mathcal{C}_{Z'/X'}
}
$$
commutes. Then we have
$$
res(c(Z \to X, \mathcal{N})) =
c_{top}(\mathcal{E}) \circ c(Z' \to X', \mathcal{N}')
$$
in $A^*(Z' \to X')^\wedge$.

\label{lemma-gysin-easy}
Let $(S, \delta)$ be as in Situation \ref{situation-setup}. Let $X$ be a scheme
locally of finite type over $S$. Let $\mathcal{N}$ be a virtual normal
sheaf for a closed subscheme $Z$ of $X$. Let $Y \to X$ be a morphism
which is locally of finite type. Given integers $r$, $n$ assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\mathcal{N}$ is locally free of rank $r$,
\item every irreducible component of $Y$ has $\delta$-dimension $n$,
\item $\dim_\delta(Z \times_X Y) \leq n - r$, and
\item for $\xi \in Z \times_X Y$ with $\delta(\xi) = n - r$
the local ring $\mathcal{O}_{Y, \xi}$ is Cohen-Macaulay.
\end{enumerate}
Then $c(Z \to X, \mathcal{N}) \cap [Y]_n = [Z \times_X Y]_{n - r}$
in $\CH_{n - r}(Z \times_X Y)$.

stage_b_substantive_review_note: Pinned chow.tex lemma at source line 12127 independently checked against proof-masked source: Under rank-r virtual normal N, pure δdimension n of components Y, expected dimension bound for Z×_X Y and Cohen–Macaulay local rings at relevant generic points, the refined Gysin class acts on [Y]_n as the fundamental intersection cycle.
